identity.name: Heritage Collection Spring Drive 6R Champagne
identity.one_liner: The rose-gold Shunbun — same cherry-blossom dial texture as the steel SBGA413, in a heavy 18k case for the Asian market's preference for warm metals.

provenance_events.description: Grand Seiko releases the rose-gold version of the Shunbun Spring Drive, two years after the steel reference launched.

narrative.story: The Shunbun dial is one of the most-cited modern Grand Seiko designs: a textured surface that reads as cherry blossom petals against a champagne tone. The steel version (SBGA413) is the everyday hero; the gold version is the warm-metal counterpart for the Japanese market.
narrative.collector_notes: The texture is created by repeated stamping, then hand-applied colour. No two dials are exactly identical.
